Messages.Author: Jason
Messages.Body:
Question - Orgy of Blood refers to "recruitment cost". Does this apply
to blood *and* pool?

ie, I burn Ossian, all my guys gain 3 blood.

If I burn a Shambling Hordes do all my guys gain 3 blood too?

Orgy of Blood
Combat
Only usable when a minion you control burns an ally controlled by
another Methuselah.
Each of your vampires gains X blood from the blood bank, where X is
the recruitment cost of the ally. (Remove excess blood.)

Thanks is advance
